_comment_password: dashboard login password, base64-encoded. Default base64('admin') = YWRtaW4=. Generate yours: [Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes('yourPassword')). This is OBSCURATION, not encryption — anyone with read access to this file can decode it. Loopback binding on dashboard means network exposure is constrained.
_comment_port: Dashboard HTTP port. Override with -Port on start-dashboard.ps1.
_comment_dashboardEnabled: When true, agent writes the most recent collect.ps1 result per package to agent/data/last-collect/<name>.json so the dashboard can show recent reports without a live center connection.
_comment_logLevel: R93: pino log level. Accepts trace|debug|info|warn|error|fatal. Default 'info' — switch to 'debug' on the field to surface HTTP request/response bodies (token/sig prefix only, never the full token), PS collector spawn lifecycle, and signed-request stamping breadcrumbs. NSSM captures stderr to its log file; nothing is lost on service stop.
